origin: Actual LogEx mainnet SQL projections, with non-timestamp fields checked against eth_getLogs. Selection only; no blockchain values changed. Source Receipt is assigned from the receipt-only acceptance ingestion provenance.
oracle: Expected groups computed outside LogEx with Python arbitrary-precision int(data,16). Even and odd refer to original global log_index parity. This selected fixture does not represent complete contract history or wallet balances.

catalog_cases.sql: SELECT topic1 AS redeemer, SUM(data) AS total_units FROM logs WHERE address='0x2260fac5e5542a773aa44fbcfedf7c193bc2c599' AND block_number BETWEEN 26080000 AND 26090000 AND topic0=event'Burn(address,uint256)' AND data_len=32 GROUP BY topic1 ORDER BY total_units DESC, redeemer LIMIT 20

SELECT topic1 AS depositor, SUM(data) AS total_units FROM logs WHERE address='0xc02aaa39b223fe8d0a0e5c4f27ead9083c756cc2' AND block_number BETWEEN 26080000 AND 26090000 AND topic0=event'Deposit(address,uint256)' AND data_len=32 GROUP BY topic1 ORDER BY total_units DESC, depositor LIMIT 20

SELECT topic3 AS asset, SUM(data) AS total_units FROM logs WHERE address='0xc3d688b66703497daa19211eedff47f25384cdc3' AND block_number BETWEEN 26080000 AND 26090000 AND topic0=event'SupplyCollateral(address,address,address,uint256)' AND data_len=32 GROUP BY topic3 ORDER BY total_units DESC, asset LIMIT 20
